scope: Separate assistant implementation contexts and cross-review of the stated boundaries; not external human approval or full-product independent signoff.

implementation_owners./root/review_core: Persistent native batch jobs, schema 4 migration, request/byte accounting, worker fetch budgets, native CLI and integration tests.
implementation_owners./root/review_service: Resumable probe evidence, storage/identity helpers, CLI probe/replay wiring and probe regressions.
implementation_owners./root/handoff_requirements: Frozen golden-query metadata, strict loader/selector, planning status and handoff documentation.
implementation_owners./root: Strict JSON API response handling, offline full-result replay, MCP job tools, integration and recorded final execution.

cross_reviews.implementation_reviewed: Root-authored replay/source-parser behavior and the probe parser fingerprint boundary.
cross_reviews.method: Read-only review and concrete counterexample identification; final re-review of fixes and corresponding regression source. Did not rerun the final tests itself.

findings.problem: A completed parser-result row without response evidence could be skipped and produce replay passed.
findings.resolution: Missing response is rejected for completed parser outcomes; only explicit timeout/network_error/error and uncertain rows may be skipped, and skips never count as matched.

findings.problem: Truncated HTTP 429 could lose the Retry-After classification.
findings.resolution: HTTP 429 is handled before truncation; scrape blocking checks also precede truncation.

findings.problem: Parser identity omitted the actual ADAPTERS registry.
findings.resolution: worker/sources/__init__.py is fingerprinted; a temporary-copy registry mutation changes the file and aggregate hashes.

findings.problem: StackExchange HTTP 200 application throttling could shorten a JSON backoff to the minimum cooldown.
findings.resolution: Strict backoff validation and the maximum applicable header/JSON/minimum delay are retained.

cross_reviews.final_scope_limited_conclusion: The four concrete findings are addressed in the reviewed code and targeted regressions; no additional blocking issue was identified in this scope.

cross_reviews.implementation_reviewed: Core-author worker request/byte budget and retired-attempt accounting boundaries.
cross_reviews.method: Read-only cross-review, two concrete findings, then read-only verification of the author fixes. Final test execution belongs to root.

findings.problem: Replaying a retired attempt or cancelling after completion could report zero usage and cause an invalid refund.
findings.resolution: Retired attempt records preserve original cumulative usage; only cancel-before-start may legitimately have zero dispatched requests.

findings.problem: A body exactly at its byte budget with delayed chunked EOF could be rejected as over-budget.
findings.resolution: Wait for bounded EOF/extra-buffer evidence under the absolute deadline and cancellation checks without consuming a probe byte.

cross_reviews.final_scope_limited_conclusion: Both findings are addressed; shared redirect/soft-redirect grants, unknown-usage charging and the persistent publication fence were also inspected.

root_execution_evidence: ctest.log and asan-core.log / asan-batch.log / asan-contracts.log, with adjacent command records.
